section.localTemplatesDesc: Template replicas cached on this node. Click to view template details.
section.sandboxesDesc: Sandbox instances currently scheduled on this node.

dialog.isolateDesc: Once isolated, this node will no longer receive new sandbox scheduling. Existing sandboxes are unaffected.
dialog.unisolateDesc: Once unisolated, this node will resume receiving new sandbox scheduling.
dialog.detailPlaceholder: Enter a reason, e.g. disk full, maintenance

empty.sandboxes: No sandboxes running on this node.

quota.title: Quota Settings
quota.unset: Not configured — the node runs on cubelet defaults.
quota.driftRatioOnly: Ratio only; overcommit values are node-local
quota.driftUnmanaged: Not managed — running on cubelet defaults
quota.savedApplied: Quota saved; applying to the node.
quota.savedSkipped: Quota saved. Push skipped: {{reason}} will retry automatically.
quota.conflictStale: The quota was changed elsewhere. Refresh the page and try again.
quota.conflictOnSave: The quota was changed elsewhere. Refresh and retry.
quota.hint: Empty fields fall back to the cubelet-derived default (host size × that node's cpu/mem_overcommit_factor; historical defaults 2.0 / 1.25). Numeric fields also accept 0.
quota.firstManagedHint: First-time adoption: fields you leave untouched keep the node's current actual value (materialized as absolute mcpu_limit / mem_limit) and are not reset. Only a field you edit and leave empty (or set to 0) falls back to the cubelet default.
quota.firstManagedConfirm: First-time adoption: fields you leave untouched keep the node's current actual value (materialized as absolute mcpu_limit / mem_limit) and are not reset. Only a field you edit and leave empty (or set to 0) falls back to the cubelet default.
quota.confirmDesc: The following changes will be pushed to node {{node}}:
quota.invalidMem: Invalid memory quota: expect a number (decimals allowed) with a Ki/Mi/Gi/Ti suffix, e.g. 262144Mi.

labels.deleteMachineTypeWarning: Unbinding the machine type makes cross-host restore require both the CPU and the host kernel again.
labels.errorInvalid: The label was rejected: check the key and value format.
labels.errorReadOnly: This label is managed by the system and cannot be edited here.
labels.isolationHint: Maintained by the isolate / unisolate action on this page, not by a label edit.
labels.keyHint: Keys may contain one '/', e.g. example.com/team. To change a key, delete the label and add it again.
labels.machineTypeBound: Bound to {{name}}. Nodes in this type can restore across host kernel versions when the CPU matches.
labels.machineTypeOrphan: The value {{name}} on this node is not in the machine type catalog. Unbind it, or create a machine type with that identifier.
labels.machineTypeSaved: Machine type updated. Cross-host restore will use the new group.
labels.machineTypeUnbound: Without a machine type, cross-host restore still requires both the CPU and the host kernel to match.
labels.readOnlyHint: Reported by Cubelet and used by the scheduler. Change them on the node, not here.
labels.replaceDesc: Saving replaces all user labels on this node with the list below. System reserved labels are not affected.
labels.replaceNoneRemoved: No user labels will be deleted.
labels.replaceProtected: Machine type and system labels are not part of this list and cannot be changed here.
labels.replaceReservedHint: System reserved labels are not modified.
labels.title: Labels
